parts.t: [shouting] FUCK! [panicked] You just took a shit at your girlfriend's house... and it won't go down.
[frustrated] So you flush it again, and now it's flooding the fucking floor with shit. [angry] Goddamn Taco Bell gordita.
[determined] So you grab the plunger to fix this unholy mess.
[nervous] Her dad is banging on the door. Probably to commit manslaughter on this toilet himself. [sarcastic] Fucking great.
[annoyed] So you use the plunger and the toilet fucking sucks it up. [disbelief] How the fuck does that work?
[panicked] You gotta clean this up before her dad walks in... [excited] and you get a genius idea—
[deadpan] Nope. Too late. Her dad barges in and loses.
[disbelief] But he also had a Taco Bell Crunchwrap Supreme, so he takes a shit anyway.
[panicked] It's too much for this toilet. [screaming] It shoots out the fucking roof!
[disgusted] Now there's shit everywhere. [deadpan] Diarrhea city, and you're the fucking mayor.
[nervous] Your girlfriend walks in to this fucking fiasco.
[amazed] This literal shit storm becomes a shit tornado and starts raining all over town. [disgusted] EUGH!
[deadpan] It takes its ass all the way to Detroit. They wouldn't even notice.
[relieved] Then the toilet lands back in the house... and it finally flushes.
